liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1992-05-23.sbd.miller.92271.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Performance features moments of brilliance mixed with rhythm fumbles and fluffed lyrics [18]
- **gd1992-05-23.150506.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min [2]
- **gd92-05-23.akg-tumulo.miller.14835.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Boomy effect affects nearly all Shoreline recordings, limiting objective quality to three stars [9]
- **gd1992-05-23.akg.swayne.85245.sbeok.flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 160 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [7]

## Around the show

- Audience was well-behaved and mellow, focused on tunes rather than parking lot scenes [11]
- Encore with Knockin' On Heaven's Door felt surreal, aided by generous hippies and liquid [13]
- Reviewer, age 16, attended with GA lawn tickets, experiencing sensory overload and high expectations [17]
- Reviewer persuaded parents to take the whole family to the following Monday show [17]
- Reviewer considers this their favorite Shoreline post-Brent show, despite the audio limitations [9]
- Performance is respectable, though not quite matching the level of Cornell 77 or Hampton 89 [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-05-23.sbd.miller.92271.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]
- **gd1992-05-23.150506.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  July 24, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Audio chain includes spaced mics, DAT transfer, and final 15-bit FLAC encoding [2]
- **gd92-05-23.akg-tumulo.miller.14835.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Paul Tumolo; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Audience Recording [4]. Also: Recorded by Paul Tumolo using AKG 460/CK8X mics, transferred via Sony DATs; Charlie Miller handled the SHN conversion for this specific audience recording file [4]
- **gd1992-05-23.akg.swayne.85245.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Scott Swayne; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460-CK8's spaced 5' apart -> TEAC DA-P20 [7]. Also: Swayne recorded using custom t-bar with 5-foot spacing, distinct from Tumolo's setup [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-05-23 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-23-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Shoreline Amphitheatre, May 23, 1992 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/SHO920523.html) [21]
- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Shoreline Amphitheatre, May 23, 1992 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/SHO920523-A.html) [22]
